positions.assessment: Sudri's search on turn 1 with Gofu on board. Vata is the standard pick: it Special Summons because Gofu and Sudri are Blackwings, then sends itself plus Deck Blackwings totalling 8 for Black-Winged Dragon. Shamal or Chinook are playable but slower.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Vata gives a quick Black-Winged Dragon, a counter sink for self-damage, and fits the playbook line.

positions.assessment: Crackdown took Simoon and redirected the Black-Winged Dragon attack onto it. Attacking the stolen Simoon deals 1200 damage and destroys Crackdown when Simoon leaves the field, and Simoon returns to our GY. Cancelling gains nothing, so confirming is right.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: The attack is forced and good. It deals 1200 damage, clears the stolen Simoon and destroys Crackdown. The stated reason is thin, but the move is right.

positions.assessment: The opponent has no Xyz monster, so Time Thief Retrograde can't be live. Twin Shadow with Shamal (Lv4 Tuner) and Armed Wing (Lv6) summons Full Armor Master, which is unaffected by other cards' effects. Black Feather Whirlwind then revives a Blackwing. This protects the board against their rebuild. The risk is a Solemn-type negate on one of the two face-down cards, and Shamal's GY effect is lost. Waiting until their End Phase is a reasonable but slower alternative.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: It puts a 3000 ATK card that other cards can't affect on the board before their main phase and gets a free revive. A negate would only cost them a card and LP, since they are at 1700.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: It keeps flexibility, but passing gives the opponent a free window with fresh cards. Holding the trap risks it being stripped or going unused when it could build a stronger board now.
